module: Declares, if absent, the rendering objects of advanced (deferred) lighting: state blocks AL_VectorLightState and AL_ConvexLightState, shaders and materials for directional lights (AL_VectorLightShader/Material, "lightinfo" target), point lights (AL_PointLight*), spot lights (AL_SpotLight*) and particles (AL_ParticlePointLight*), as well as the default materials AL_DefaultPrePassMaterial and AL_DefaultShadowMaterial (double-sided). Loaded by lighting/advanced/init.lua. No exported function; only a low-level rendering modder cares about it.
notes: The materials read the G-buffers (#prepass[RT0..RT5], #prepass[Depth]), the shadow map ($dynamiclight), the cookies ($dynamiclightmask, #cloudTransmittanceCookie) and the masks #ssaoMask, #sssMask, #sunShadowMask.
AL_ConvexLightState chooses zFunc GFXCmpLessEqual if $Scene::useReversedDepthBuffer is true, otherwise GFXCmpGreaterEqual; stencilRef = 4 for both light state blocks.
Shadow maps are sampled with SamplerClampPoint (code comment: some cards do not filter identically).
